caption: The drawing is a square composition bordered by a thick frame consisting of green, red, and grey lines. Within the square, there is a symmetrical design featuring geometric and floral motifs. The central area contains an architectural shape resembling three columns or pillars, with an arched element above and intersecting dark brown lines forming a V or compass-like shape pointing downward. Surrounding this central motif are four circular forms, one in each quadrant, each divided into sections colored with red, beige, black, and off-white, and each with petal or leaf-like shapes radiating outward. Between the central area and the corners, there is a thick, curving, orange-brown ribbon forming a loose frame around the architecture and connecting to the circular motifs. The background is rendered in a pale grayish-blue. The overall color palette includes muted shades of red, brown, black, yellow, beige, gray, and white. The design is balanced and displays symmetry along both the vertical and horizontal axes.
title: Masonic Sign
